description: Sends a big file in parts straight to storage, so a dropped connection resumes instead of starting over. Returns part_size and parts_total; PUT part n's bytes (exactly bytes long) to its url and keep the ETag response header. The first parts' urls come back here; media_multipart_parts gives more, or fresh ones after an hour. When every part is sent, media_multipart_complete. Open uploads are dropped after 24 hours.

kind.description: proxy: the iPhone app's 720p copy of a clip (video, 400 MB at most), kept out of the library

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: media_multipart_start
title: Start a resumable upload
